home.hero.badge: The AI operating system for business
home.hero.title: Run your whole business — and let Kuza sell for you, wherever you sell.
home.hero.subtitle: Kuza keeps every branch on one source of truth — stock, sales, invoices, books, payroll — while AI agents answer your customers on WhatsApp and Instagram and turn conversations into orders your books already understand.
home.channels.heading: One platform, wherever your customers are
home.ripple.title: One sale updates everything. In one transaction.
home.ripple.body: Whether it's rung up at the counter or closed by an agent in a DM, a sale ripples through your whole operation the moment it happens — so your books can never drift from your stock.
home.ripple.step1.title: Stock allocated
home.ripple.step1.body: FIFO, LIFO or FEFO — your rule. Short at this branch? Kuza spills over to the next one.
home.ripple.step2.title: Batch traced
home.ripple.step2.body: Every line remembers which batch and supplier it came from, at what cost.
home.ripple.step3.title: Ledger appended
home.ripple.step3.body: One immutable row per movement, written in the same transaction as the sale.
home.ripple.step4.title: Books posted
home.ripple.step4.body: Revenue, tax, cost of goods — the double-entry journal writes itself.
home.ripple.step5.title: Dashboard updated
home.ripple.step5.body: Owners see it instantly. Nothing to re-key, nothing to reconcile at month-end.
home.feature.selling.title: Sell wherever your customers are
home.feature.selling.body: Your AI agent converses on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram — quoting live stock, taking the order and checking payment against your rules. The counter, the table, the pump and the marketplace all flow into the same place.
home.feature.selling.point2: A DM becomes a real order — booked to your ledger
home.feature.branches.title: Every branch. One truth.
home.feature.branches.body: Per-branch stock, prices and takings — with access that follows your org, not the other way round. Staff see only their branches, managers approve what arrives, owners see everything, everywhere.
home.feature.branches.point1: Inter-branch transfers with a manager receive step — stock never vanishes in transit
home.feature.branches.point2: Short on stock? A sale spills over to the next branch automatically
home.feature.accounting.title: Books that write themselves.
home.feature.accounting.body: Every sale, goods receipt, invoice, customer payment and payroll run posts its own balanced journal entry — automatically, in the same transaction. Trial balance, P&L, balance sheet and general ledger, ready whenever you are.
home.feature.accounting.point2: Books that can never drift from your stock
home.feature.copilot.title: Ask your business anything.
home.feature.copilot.body: Kuza Copilot answers from your own data — sales, stock, payroll, books — across every branch or just one. The numbers are computed in code; the AI only explains them. It will never invent a figure.
home.feature.copilot.point1: Answers grounded in your real data
home.feature.copilot.point2: General or branch-scoped, in plain language

home.industries.title: Dressed for the trade it runs.
home.industries.body: Restaurants, retail, wholesale, services, fuel and manufacturing — each gets its own scene and the specific jobs Kuza does for it, not a generic pitch.
home.marketplace.title: Restock from suppliers without leaving your books.
home.marketplace.body: Find suppliers on the Kuza network, place a purchase order, and watch it land in your stock and their invoice — both sides reconciled automatically. Pay instantly from your Kuza wallet or confirm a bank transfer.

home.marketplace.point2: Wallet transfers are atomic and can never go negative.

home.trust.title: Built like a payments company. Because your money is in here.
home.trust.body: Kuza treats every naira with the discipline of financial infrastructure — not the optimism of a spreadsheet.
home.trust.item1.title: An immutable stock ledger
home.trust.item1.body: Every stock movement is one append-only row — written in the same database transaction as the change itself.
home.trust.item2.title: Verified payments only
home.trust.item2.body: Bank transfers reconcile through signature-verified webhooks, idempotently. Nothing is marked paid on a screenshot.
home.trust.item3.title: Rules-based payment verification
home.trust.item3.body: You set the conditions — amount, payer, date. Every money-moving action is checked against your rules and audited, with an approval queue for anything that needs a human.
home.trust.item4.title: Access that follows your org
home.trust.item4.body: Branch-scoped permissions, custom roles, and 2FA gating on sensitive settlement changes.
home.trust.item5.title: Your business, isolated
home.trust.item5.body: Every business lives in its own isolated database schema — your data never shares a table with anyone else's.
home.trust.item6.title: Everything on the record
home.trust.item6.body: Audit logs across the platform, and a full action log for every AI conversation and tool call.
home.faq.title: Questions, answered.
home.faq.a1: An AI operating system for business: one ERP that runs your whole operation — stock, sales, money and people — with AI agents on the front line that take orders and check payment against your rules, then post everything to your books.
home.faq.q2: How do the AI agents handle payments?
home.faq.a2: You set the conditions. Every money-moving action is checked against your rules (amount, payer name, date) and fully audited. Today those actions land in your approval queue before anything moves; rule-based auto-clear of the safe ones is the direction we're building toward. Money only ever moves through idempotent, signature-verified paths.
home.faq.q3: Which channels can agents sell on?
home.faq.a3: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram and web chat, using real Meta and Telegram connect flows — plus the shop floor, the table, the pump and the marketplace.
home.faq.q4: Is everything really one system of record?
home.faq.a4: Yes. Stock is a shared core: a sale deducts it, accounting sees it and the dashboard reflects it — automatically, in one database transaction, across every branch and channel.
home.faq.a5: Start with a free 14-day all-access trial. After that you pay only for what you use — per vertical/common module plus usage — with the AI assists included. Prices shown are illustrative unless stated.
home.finalCta.title: Run the whole thing. Let Kuza sell for you.
home.finalCta.body: Fourteen days, every module, all access. Then keep only what you use.
